title: The "Rough" HAR Model
abstract: arXiv:2609.21587v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper proposes discrete-time approximations to rough continuous-time models of realized variance (RV). The leading rough models can be viewed as autoregressive processes driven by fractional Gaussian noise. We show that the Wold representation of this noise concentrates its dependence at the first lag when the Hurst parameter is below one half. Augmenting the autoregressive (AR) and heterogeneous autoregressive (HAR) models with a first-order moving-average (MA(1)) component therefore approximates the roughness, and the MA coefficient maps almost linearly into the Hurst parameter. We refer to these extensions as the "rough" AR and "rough" HAR models. Estimating them on the log RV of ten ETFs, we find negative MA coefficients for every asset, and the implied Hurst parameters align closely with the estimates from the continuous-time models. translated_abstract: 本文提出了已实现方差（RV）的粗糙连续时间模型的离散时间近似。主流的粗糙模型可以被视为由分数高斯噪声驱动的自回归过程。我们证明，当Hurst参数小于二分之一时，该噪声的Wold表示将其依赖性集中在第一滞后项上。因此，在自回归（AR）和异质自回归（HAR）模型中加入一阶移动平均（MA(1)）成分即可近似这种粗糙性，并且MA系数与Hurst参数之间几乎呈线性映射关系。我们将这些扩展模型称为“粗糙”AR模型和“粗糙”HAR模型。在十只ETF的对数已实现方差上对这些模型进行估计，我们发现所有资产的MA系数均为负值，且隐含的Hurst参数与连续时间模型的估计结果高度一致。在HAR文献中，负的MA(1)成分是一个一直被忽视的重要特征……
tldr: 本文提出在AR和HAR模型中加入一阶移动平均（MA(1)）成分来离散近似粗糙连续时间已实现方差模型，并证明MA系数与Hurst参数几乎线性对应，实证发现所有资产均存在负MA系数且隐含的Hurst参数与连续时间模型估计高度一致。
